name: Nifoxipam

tolerance.full: within a couple of days of continuous use

toxicities: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: An uncommon and relatively new RC benzodiazepine, and metabolite of the hypnotic benzodiazepine flunitrazepam. Little information about the pharmacological properties of this drug exists. Likely to be a strong sedative and hypnotic.
metabolism: Evidence is from a peer-reviewed study identifying the main human urinary metabolites of the designer nitrobenzodiazepines clonazolam, meclonazepam and nifoxipam (Anal Bioanal Chem 2016, PMID 27071765). Nifoxipam was extensively metabolized, but instead mainly excreted as the acetamino metabolite and a glucuronic acid conjugate of the parent. Nifoxipam is the 3-hydroxy-desmethylflunitrazepam metabolite of flunitrazepam, formed by in vivo demethylation of the parent followed by 3-hydroxylation of the benzodiazepine ring.
